fusions.name: Silk Spit
fusions.desc: Spits silk that deals 4 damage, with a 60% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Binding Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of silk that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks it back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchor Line
fusions.desc: Spins a snare onto the nearest enemy that waits 12 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles trigger a blast that deals 20 damage.

fusions.name: Waiting Threads
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 4. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for part of your weapon damage per strand. Unfed, a strand fades every 6 seconds.
